cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(mimi_rlottie_render LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build rlottie statically for the helper" FORCE)
set(LOTTIE_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable dynamic Lottie modules" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(../rlottie rlottie-build)
target_compile_definitions(rlottie PRIVATE LOTTIE_DISABLE_ARM_NEON)
add_executable(mimi-rlottie-render main.cpp)
target_compile_features(mimi-rlottie-render PRIVATE cxx_std_14)
target_include_directories(mimi-rlottie-render PRIVATE ../rlottie/inc)
target_link_libraries(mimi-rlottie-render PRIVATE rlottie)
